name: @w6w-apps/intercom
description: Manage Intercom contacts, companies, conversations, notes and tags via its REST API, plus triggers for contact, company and conversation events, any other webhook topic, new notes and new tags.

w6w.longDescription:
Intercom manages contacts, companies and conversations from a workflow — creating, updating, searching for and deleting contacts, and upserting companies through a single create-or-update action rather than requiring a workflow to check existence first.

Conversations can be fetched individually or listed in bulk, and replied to directly, so a workflow can respond to an inbound message — or follow up on one — without an agent opening Intercom's own inbox. Notes can be logged against a contact and tags can be listed, rounding out the record-keeping a support or sales process needs.

A fit for routing support conversations based on external context, keeping company and contact records in sync with a CRM, or triggering an automated reply when a conversation matches a known pattern.

Triggers start a workflow on contact, company and conversation events or any other Intercom webhook topic (signed webhooks, set up in the Developer Hub), and on new notes on a contact or new tags (polled).
